# End-to-end healing study v2 (throwaway; generated by report_healing2.py from healing2_*.json; do not edit by hand)

12 function regimes (4 classes, 32 inputs, 10 batches of 64 per regime unless stated, then two revisits); the pool is the stage-3 pool with the stage-4b transfer test on. Accuracy is the mean over the 12 regimes of the final held-out accuracy, in points. +-: standard error over seeds. `vs none` / `vs none_h`: mean and standard error of the paired difference over the seeds both arms share.

False spawns are injected by handing a batch of a regime the pool already knows to the spawn routine with the extend option switched off (the way the merge audit forced one): config a injects one per regime (at batch 3), config b two (at batches 3 and 4). A duplicate is born a clone of its parent (lambda = 1.0, affinity 1.0).
